## Clinical justification

This patient has a 12mm lesion on his right temple present for six months with rapid growth over the past three months. The lesion has a non-healing ulcer at its centre with a pearlescent rolled border and telangiectasia -- consistent with a BCC. He has significant background sun damage from decades of outdoor work. No prior skin cancer history.
